editor.helpHint: Writing for the first time? Markdown makes writing easier. See the guide for usage and syntax.
editor.helpOpen: Syntax guide (opens in a new window)

details.title: Collapsible details
details.description: Hide supporting details behind a clickable heading.

tip.title: Tip
tip.description: Call attention to a practical recommendation.

danger.title: Danger
danger.description: Emphasize a serious risk or irreversible action.

checklist.title: Titled task list
checklist.description: Group tasks in a card with a title and live completion count.

spoiler.title: Spoiler area
spoiler.description: Collapse spoiler content containing multiple paragraphs or lists.

help.title: Markdown writing guide
help.lead: Write clear articles and discussions with familiar Markdown plus collapsible, callout, step and spoiler blocks. In discussions you can also mention people, quote posts and embed database entries.

basic.title: Markdown basics
basic.description: These familiar forms work in articles, discussions and reviews.
basic.headingTocHint: Tips automatically generate a table of contents from H1–H4 headings. Follow the content hierarchy and do not use headings merely to enlarge text.
basic.heading: Headings (H1–H4)

images.title: Images
images.description: Images always appear as standalone blocks for readable guides and long-form posts. Add Pandoc attributes immediately after an image to set its size. Setting only width or height preserves its intrinsic ratio; setting both uses the requested dimensions. Values are pixels from 1 to 4096.

formatting.title: Text formatting
formatting.description: Select text in the editor, then apply a background highlight, colored underline, allow-listed text color or text size.
formatting.attributesDescription: Pandoc-style syntax keeps attributes for the same range in one attribute block. Nest only when the text ranges differ. Attribute order does not affect the result.

combined.title: Combine the same range
combined.description: When color, size and underline apply to the same text, keep the attributes together.

nested.title: Nest different ranges
nested.description: The outer size applies to all text while the inner color applies only to part of it.

avoid.title: Repeat nesting for one range
avoid.description: This parses correctly but is verbose; use a single attribute block instead.

advanced.title: Advanced blocks
advanced.description: Start a block with ::: and finish it with another ::: line.

examples.infoBody: The album debuted at **M3-2026 Spring**; mail order starts later.
examples.tipBody: Tracks 3 and 7 show the album's style best.
examples.warningBody: The reissue drops the bonus CD; check the edition when buying second-hand.
examples.dangerBody: There is no official digital release; "lossless" copies online are unauthorised.
examples.stepsFirst: Open the album page and go to Lyrics
examples.stepsSecond: Pick the track and paste the lyrics
examples.spoilerBody: Two minutes of silence after the last song, a **hidden track** begins.

nesting.title: Nesting blocks
nesting.description: Different advanced blocks can be nested. Keep each opening and closing marker on its own line so the structure stays clear.

spoilers.title: Whole-tip, block and inline spoilers
spoilers.description: Choose the smallest spoiler boundary that protects readers.
spoilers.whole: When everything you write is a spoiler, say so in the title and put the body in a ::: spoiler block.
spoilers.block: Use a ::: spoiler block to hide multiple paragraphs or a list.
spoilers.inline: Use the inline syntax shown below for a short phrase within a sentence. Its text is obscured until clicked.
spoilers.inlineBefore: The last track on this album is
spoilers.inlineAfter: , and only the first pressing has it.

security.title: Safe content
security.description: Raw HTML and executable URLs are not accepted. Use Markdown links and the supported blocks instead.

discussion.title: Discussion extras
discussion.description: These work in discussions; the site fills in names, avatars and floor numbers.
discussion.mentionHint: Typing {'@'} opens a list of people. Mentioned users are notified; unknown names stay plain text.
discussion.quoteHint: "Quote" under a post inserts this for you. Select part of a post first to quote just that part.
discussion.refHint: Typing [[ opens a search. On a line of its own it shows as a card; inside a sentence, as a link. Pasting the address of an album, artist or other page here turns it into one.
discussion.refTypes: Types: album, artist, entry, franchise, event, track, topic, article.
